Rechecked both chamber projections, recorded Qatar’s mediation contact and Herzog’s recommendation tally, and expanded the House GOP leadership postmortem. The Nov 4 Los Angeles grand jury outcome remains unreviewed. The Nov 6 Cook filing and Venezuela TPS disposition remain pending verification.
